title: The relaxation limit of a homogeneous two-phase flow model: isothermal case
summary: This paper investigates the asymptotic behavior of a hyperbolic relaxation system designed for homogeneous two-phase flows in the limit of vanishing relaxation time. The governing equations comprise conservation laws for mixture mass and momentum, supplemented by a transport equation for the gas phase mass that includes a stiff relaxation source term. This source term drives the system toward local thermodynamic equilibrium.
